name: Microgrid resource command-timeout monitor
aliases: microgrids Microgrid supervisory and communication interfaces
summary: Reports that the expected acknowledgement or feedback was not received for an assigned command.
description: Reports that the expected acknowledgement or feedback was not received for an assigned command. Microgrid supervision coordinates measurements, control authority and resource communication without replacing local protection. Each resource value needs a named measurement boundary, freshness condition and intended control use.

In a microgrid control room, the operator can see source availability, active constraints and current operating mode. A communication failure should remain distinguishable from an electrical resource failure. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Command and feedback timing” at the input and “Resource command timeout” at the output. The affected control authority must be identified.
